quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson questions the Timberwolves' future roster competitiveness
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Edwards has said he's paying attention to the roster. How are we going to compete with the Spurs?
quotes.quote: Anthony Edwards has said he's paying attention to the roster. How are we going to compete with the San Antonio Spurs? How are we going to compete with the Oklahoma City Thunder? How are we going to compete with the Los Angeles Lakers at this point? They were ahead of them. What changes do you think he wants?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson worries about Jaden McDaniels' injury impact
quotes.excerpt: I feel like the Jaden McDaniels injury is still going to haunt them next year.
quotes.quote: I feel like the Jaden McDaniels injury is still going to haunt them next year. He's a big piece for them.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues that team success defines greatness
quotes.excerpt: It's not really the player, it's the team. Kobe Bryant had a better team than LeBron James.
quotes.quote: It's not really the player, it's the team. Kobe Bryant had a better team than LeBron James. Tim Duncan had a better team than LeBron James. If LeBron James was on the Spurs, we would have crowned Kobe Bryant way earlier.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on handling pressure and staying grounded
quotes.excerpt: I think the key is acceptance a lot of times and to taking a step back.
quotes.quote: I think the key is acceptance a lot of times and to taking a step back, realizing all the, you know, the journey that's behind us and what's ahead of us, and just being okay with who I am, where I am, what I'm doing. I think, at the end of the day, this is everything that I wish for, so there's no reason to really overthink it or, I mean, this is what I'm built for.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs need aggressive start from Victor Wembanyama to win
quotes.excerpt: They just got to come out aggressive like they did last series.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: What do the Spurs need to do to have a chance to win the game? Big game from Victor Wembanyama from the start. They just got to come out aggressive like they did last series.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs need contributions from players outside of Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: Someone outside of Victor Wembanyama needs to come to the party.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I think with the Spurs, someone outside of Victor Wembanyama needs to come to the party.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I think Fox, bro. I need a better game from Fox.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox is the key to Spurs success
quotes.excerpt: Fox is the fucking key, bro. Because he's been playing very inconsistent.
quotes.quote: Fox is the fucking key, bro. Because he's been playing very inconsistent. He hasn't had a good game yet. So, I'm thinking Fox needs some from him.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' three-guard lineup is their best defensive option
quotes.quote: I think their best bet is that three-guard lineup with Fox, Castle, and Hart. As much as you can play that lineup, you got to do it just for the sole purpose of that means Jalen Brunson has to guard somebody. You have to make him guard.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephon Castle's defensive impact on the series
quotes.quote: I think Stephon Castle is out the series, bro. You know how some, like we said, Chet was out the series last game. What the fuck is Castle? He's not going to run through Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Jalen Williams. You got to think, Castle was getting downhill running short, slow-stepping motherfuckers, laying them last series. He ain't doing that this series. Why? His matchup has been Shai Gilgeous-Alexander. That's neutralized.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' roster depth and versatility is a major advantage
quotes.quote: What I love with New York is you don't know who's going to show up. Meaning, in a good way. One day it's going to be Mikal Bridges, next day it's fucking OG Anunoby, then it's fucking Landry Shamet off the bench, fucking giving you 20 in 12 minutes. Mikal is hooping. Even Josh Hart, even though on the offensive end he ain't doing his thing, but on the defensive side and the rebounds, he's doing his fucking part, fam. New York is as a complete hole. They doing what they got to do to win, bro.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks' roster depth makes them a championship contender
quotes.excerpt: It's just a perfect recipe for a championship. They got great coaching.
quotes.quote: You got guys like Mikal Bridges coming off the bench playing big minutes, hitting big shots, making plays. It's just a perfect recipe for a championship. They got great coaching. I just feel like it's their time right now.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tom Thibodeau's coaching success with the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: Everybody was a little taken back when Tom Thibodeau was fired, right? They just made it to the Eastern Conference finals.
quotes.quote: Everybody was a little taken back when Tom Thibodeau was fired, right? They just made it to the Eastern Conference finals.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Role players are essential for winning championships
quotes.excerpt: Role players can win you games in the finals.
quotes.quote: You most said role players can win you games in the finals. But they have OG Anunoby on the Raptors was not a role player. He became a role player coming to the Knicks. Mikal was featured in Brooklyn. So they got different type of role players that have been in this moment.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikal Bridges trade was a smart move for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: If they win a championship, that shit makes that trade worth it.
quotes.quote: That Mikal Bridges trade was last year. They was talking about it was one of the worst trades in NBA history. If they win a championship, that shit makes that trade worth it.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Year-to-year performance and team chemistry determine success
quotes.quote: Year to year, how you playing matters and how teams are clicking matters. A big loss for OKC and the reason I think they lost the series and also why the Knicks are doing so well, last year Lou Dort hooped. He didn't play this series because he was not making shots, he was doing a lot of erratic shit. Not having him on the court, Castle might not be doing what he was doing.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's role as a star player
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is probably one of the clutchest players in the game right now.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson is probably one of the clutchest players in the game right now. You see what I'm saying? Now that you able to have Mikal Bridges missing fucking two shots and OG Anunoby doing his thing, you got Shamet giving you 12, Jose Alvarado giving you seven, and Mikal giving you seven. And like, what the fuck are you supposed to do with that?

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitchell Robinson's defensive contribution
quotes.excerpt: Mitchell Robinson hit three free throws.
quotes.quote: Mitchell Robinson hit three free throws. You fouled him to not make free throws. And he played defense with a broke finger.
